authorization.request: 用户要求修复 DSH Desktop 插件商城详情页没有安装、卸载、启动、关闭等按钮的问题，并要求本机验收和按 CI 检查后的 PR 上线。

objective: 在 Desktop 商城列表显示可见的门禁状态操作，在详情正文始终显示安装、启动、关闭、卸载四个操作；不可执行时用可读的禁用样式和原因说明，绝不调用写接口。

change.desktopDetails: 未安装条目显示安装和其他生命周期状态按钮；已安装条目显示四种操作状态，只有当前可执行操作可触发；禁用按钮保持可读且说明原因。
change.safety: 保留固定 Commit、精确 DSH 兼容性、Desktop Profile 声明、官方 pluginManager、来源匹配、Bundle 可移除和商城自身保护。

gates: Bind current main Commit 4a60b509 and exact file precondition and reviewed content hashes.
Run all repository checks and exact-head CI including DSH upgrade and runtime matrices.
Disabled operations never call Desktop pluginManager mutation APIs; enabled operations retain exact package and full Commit confirmation.
Publish source only through a CI-checked pull request using the connected short-lived GitHub credential.
Keep Catalog pin and public storefront publication as a separate fresh Catalog plan after source merge.
Keep any real Desktop Profile package update in its own typed plan with backup and explicit authorization.

rollback.source: Revert only the exact source PR through a CI-checked PR.
rollback.desktopProfile: Source PR does not update the real Desktop Profile; any local update is separately planned, backed up, and performed with the official DSH CLI.

healthCheck: Desktop list and details render the lifecycle actions; disabled reasons match current Catalog, install state, source trust, and DSH compatibility; full CI and post-merge Catalog/public readback pass.
